sources: Hit structure: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0034_typhoea_* (game 1.6), as efsim kit-draft v2 compiles it. Projectile and ability-entity hits take their parent's blackboard (LaunchProjectile / SpawnAbilityEntity assignBlackboard) and split it with SimpleCalcBBAction literals (operation 2 = ×, 3 = ÷), written here as `factor`: attack1 2 arrows × atk_scale/2; attack3 2 waves × atk_scale/2 (3 arrows per wave, one damages a target: buff_chr_0034_typhoea_attack_3_*_damagetaken gate); attack4 atk_scale×0.35 + 5 × atk_scale×0.13; battle skill 2 arrows × atk_scale×0.5; combo 7 arrows × atk_scale/7 and 18 ticks × atk_scale_persistent/18; ultimate main hit atk_scale_main, Hail of Arrows rains 3 ticks × atk_scale_outer/3, empowered rain 5 × atk_scale_center×0.08 + atk_scale_center×0.6 (all × potential_damge_up). Frames are launch frames (projectiles) or spawn frame + entity frame (ability entities); travel time isn't in the data (Ti2), so the logs' ~0.33 s from a Power Shot to its burst isn't modelled. Every hit dealt from another SkillData file is detached (on its way, it survives an interrupt).

Skill descriptions (CharGrowthTable + I18nTextTable_EN). Battle skill: "Typhoeus leaps into the air and enters a short Hovering state, during which she can unleash 5 Aerial Basic Attacks (ABATK) … Whenever an ABATK hits an enemy with Nature Infliction, it consumes 1 stack of Nature Infliction, grants Typhoeus 1 Sign, and gives additional Ultimate Energy. If Typhoeus has Hunting Arrow(s), she consumes 1 Hunting Arrow and converts the ABATK into a Power Shot. Power Shot: After hitting an enemy, Power Shot forcibly applies 1 instance of Nature Burst; if the Power Shot consumes the target's Nature Infliction, then increase the DMG dealt by this Nature Burst. If Typhoeus is the controlled operator, her 5th ABATK is regarded as a Final Strike and a Power Shot, and does not consume Hunting Arrows." Talent 1: "Whenever a Nature Burst is triggered on an enemy, Typhoeus gains 1 Sign. DMG dealt by attacks empowered by consuming Hunting Arrows is increased to {atk_scale_enhence} times the original. When entering battle, Typhoeus immediately gains {energy_enterfight} Sign(s). Typhoeus can have up to 4 Hunting Arrows and 8 Signs." Combo: "COMBO TRIGGER: When Typhoeus reaches max Signs. Typhoeus converts all her Signs to Hunting Arrows and resets her Aerial Basic Attack (ABATK) attempts … Enemies in the Barrage Array take Nature DMG over time, are slowed, and suffer increased Nature Burst DMG Taken. Every 2 Signs convert to 1 Hunting Arrow." Ultimate: "… She then enters a Hovering state and her Aerial Basic Attack (ABATK) attempts are reset. For her next 5 ABATKs, hitting an enemy triggers a Hail of Arrows … Casting the ultimate gives {arrow_num_given} Hunting Arrows immediately."

Hovering (buff_chr_0034_typhoea_floatingmode) is the kit buff `hovering`, created at the cast of the battle skill and the ultimate (frame 0) and ended by the data's ends: the 5th ABATK at its frame 15; shot 4 at frame 45 when controlled (CheckMainCharacterCondition → FinishBuffAdvanced); an idle hover through the follow-ups floating_loop (cast at shot 1–2 frame 22, shot 3 frame 23, battle skill 37, floating combo 67, ultimate 89) → floating_end (loop frame 27) → hover ends (end frame 8); and any skill outside its inherit list (grounded attacks, finisher, grounded combo). A skill's delayed cast-trigger actions are its own: the player's next shot cuts the loop. The 10 s of the data is the ChangeSkillAction's (combo slot → combo_skillfloating), only made when she's controlled as the hover starts (kit buff combo_swap). Off-field, the shots chain by themselves (CastSkill when not controlled: battle skill 32, floating combo 57, ultimate 89; shots 1–2 at 22, 3 at 23, 4 at 35); off-field shots jump to other timeline sections by distance (KNOWN in skillCompile.test.ts), the kit has section 0's frames.

Resources: Signs (buff_chr_0034_typhoea_normal_skill_arrow_energy, max 8) and Hunting Arrows (buff_chr_0034_typhoea_normal_skill_arrow_num, max 4) are kit stacks; the ABATK attempt index (EntityBB_floating_attack_index) is stack `abatk`, gating which shot can be cast next; `hail` counts the Hail of Arrows left (5 − the data's trigger_times). A shot with an arrow uses one (Power Shot: atk_scale_base × atk_scale_enhence, then a forced Nature burst × potential_damage_rate, × enchence_burst_damage_rate when it consumed Nature Infliction); without one it's a plain shot (atk_scale_base). Each shot consumes 1 Nature Infliction stack (floating_attack1_01_projhit FinishBuffAdvanced finishLayerCnt 1) for a Sign (arrow_energy_buffer_2) and usp_recover energy. Every Nature burst on the enemy, anyone's, gives 1 Sign (talent 1: aura buff_chr_0034_typhoea_passitive_enemy_listennaturalspellbrust; 0.2 s adding cooldown). The combo converts Signs to arrows at frame 35 (common_func_arrowreload: (Signs − 1) ÷ 2, which the logs show rounds to 4 at 8 Signs; written as Signs × 0.5). Fight start (passive_arrowrecover): energy_enterfight Signs (talent 1: 1/2/4) and 4 arrows (the dungeon categories benchmarks and the fixtures are in; a scenario's startStacks for other fights).

Verification: efsim zmdlogs check on fixtures/pending/zmdlogs-dbaee23b801d.json (P1, weapon, Deep Rampart), zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f.json and zmdlogs-bdf223db8e49.json (P5), zmdlogs-d9e59d0fb737.json (P0; its Typhoeus hits after t=9605 are ×1.54–1.9 above the kit, unexplained, but under Corrosion, so unquantified; its ultimate main hit at t=4415 is ×1.1585 with no logged buff, so that hit's event key is left off). Results in docs/kit-batches/batch-1/chr_0034_typhoea.md, "Kit (2026-10-18)".
Only ultimate_skillfloating is in CharGrowthTable's ultimate group (chr_0034_typhoea_ultimate_skill is unused), so the ultimate always uses its values (atk_scale_outer 0.75 at level 12).

stacks.label: Signs
stacks.note: buff_chr_0034_typhoea_normal_skill_arrow_energy maxStackCnt 8; talent 1: "up to … 8 Signs". Fight start: energy_enterfight of talent 1's passive_arrowrecover (1/2/4; 0 while talent 1 isn't learned). A Sign added at 8 opens the combo (combo_trigger_combo).

stacks.label: Hunting Arrows
stacks.note: buff_chr_0034_typhoea_normal_skill_arrow_num maxStackCnt 4. Fight start: 4 in the dungeon categories of passive_arrowrecover (boss rush, resource, high difficulty, …: where benchmarks and the fixtures are), else what she held when the last fight ended; set a scenario's startStacks for other fights.

stacks.label: ABATK attempts
stacks.note: EntityBB_floating_attack_index: how many shots of this hover she has fired (each shot +1 at its cast). Reset (−5) by the battle skill's cast, the floating combo's cast (SwitchAction at frame 0), the ultimate at frame 61 and the hover's end.

stacks.label: Hail of Arrows left
stacks.note: 5 − trigger_times of buff_chr_0034_typhoea_ultimate_skill_cause_subarrowrain: set to 5 by the ultimate at frame 61, −1 per Hail of Arrows, 0 when its 5 s end.

buffs.label: Hovering
buffs.note: buff_chr_0034_typhoea_floatingmode: until one of its ends (see sources). Gates the floating shots and the floating combo.

buffs.label: Hovering ATK (P1)
buffs.note: buff_chr_0034_typhoea_potential_atkup (ATK + atk_up; attributeType 2, formula item 6), created by floatingmode when the casting skill's potential_atkup is 1 (P1 sets it, and atk_up 0.18, on the battle skill and the ultimate alike). Applied with the hover from P1, ended with it.

buffs.label: Combo slot: hovering combo
buffs.note: floatingmode's ChangeSkillAction (combo → combo_skillfloating, lifeTimeType 2, 10 s), made only when she's controlled as the hover starts (CheckMainCharacterCondition in floatingmode buffEvent 5); ended with the hover.

buffs.label: Barrage Array: Nature Burst DMG taken
buffs.note: buff_chr_0034_typhoea_combo_enemy_debuff, given by the combo's Barrage Array (combo_persistentdamage aura, 180 frames = persistent_time 6 s) while the enemy stands in it: damage_up = persistent_naturalburst_increase (0.10 at level 12, P3 +0.06) on hits with decorate mask 33554432 (Arts Bursts only, of any operator). Logged as a damageTaken zone; fixtures/pending/zmdlogs-dbaee23b801d.json shows it only on bursts.

buffs.label: Hail of Arrows window
buffs.note: buff_chr_0034_typhoea_ultimate_skill_cause_subarrowrain (5 s), created at the ultimate's frame 61.

triggers.note: Talent 1: "Whenever a Nature Burst is triggered on an enemy, Typhoeus gains 1 Sign" (passitive_enemy_listennaturalspellbrust on every Nature-burst tag, hers and teammates'; arrow_energy_buffer_1/3 have a 0.2 s adding cooldown). CharGrowthTable: "COMBO TRIGGER: When Typhoeus reaches max Signs.": arrow_energy creates combo_trigger_combo whenever a Sign is added at 8.
The other Sign source: a shot's consumption (its Sign is gained before triggers run), so this opens the window exactly when that Sign is added at 8. Her only consumptions are the shots'.
CreateBuff floatingmode at frame 0 of the battle skill and the ultimate; it creates potential_atkup when the skill's potential_atkup is 1 (P1) and swaps the combo slot when she's controlled.
The battle skill starts a hover from the first attempt.
Frame 61: CreateBuff arrow_num × arrow_num_given (2; P5 +1), the ABATK attempts reset, cause_subarrowrain (5 Hail of Arrows within 5 s).
Hail of Arrows not used within the 5 s are lost.

hits.label: Hail of Arrows tick
hits.note: ultimate_skill_arrowrain_sub1, spawned at the shot's hit: 3 ticks of atk_scale_outer ÷ 3 (× potential_damge_up) at its frames 6, 9, 12 (mask 512).

hits.label: Empowered Hail of Arrows tick
hits.note: ultimate_skill_arrowrain_sub2 (the 5th Hail of Arrows): atk_scale_2 = atk_scale_center × 0.08 at its frames 6–13.

hits.label: Empowered Hail of Arrows blast
hits.note: ultimate_skill_arrowrain_sub2: atk_scale_1 = atk_scale_center × 0.6 at its frame 30 (mask 4608). fixtures/pending/zmdlogs-d9e59d0fb737.json's implied multipliers 0.3017 (×5) and 2.2629 are 7.50 apart, as 0.6/0.08.

triggers.note: cause_subarrowrain: on her damage carrying an ABATK arrow tag (1208750764 plain, 959424907 Power Shot; not the bursts') while trigger_times < 5 and its 0.2 s timer is off: count it and spawn sub1 (counts 1–4) or sub2 (count 5). Another target of the same arrow gets one without counting (one enemy here).
Each shot is one attempt (EntityBB_floating_attack_index).
combo_skillfloating timeline action 39 (frame 0): SwitchAction resets the ABATK index.

Frame 35: common_func_arrowreload, arrows = (Signs − 1) ÷ 2 = 3.5 at 8 Signs, which fixtures/zmdlogs-bdf223db8e49.json shows as 4 (all 5 shots after the floating combo burst), then all Signs removed. Written as Signs × 0.5 (the combo needs 8 Signs).
Frame 22: CastSkill floating_attack2 when not controlled, else floating_loop (idle; the player's next shot from frame 18 cuts it).
As chain_1.
As chain_1, at frame 23.
Frame 35: CastSkill floating_attack5 when not controlled.
Shot 4 has no loop: controlled and idle, timeline action 40 (frame 45) ends floatingmode (CheckMainCharacterCondition → FinishBuffAdvanced) and resets the index.
The 5th shot ends floatingmode at frame 15.
Frame 32: CastSkill floating_attack1 when not controlled.
Frame 37: CastSkill floating_loop (unconditional in the data; off-field the shot at 32 has cut the skill by then).
Frame 57: CastSkill floating_attack1 when not controlled.
Frame 67: CastSkill floating_loop.
Frame 89: CastSkill floating_attack1 when not controlled, else floating_loop while hovering.
floating_loop frame 27: CastSkill floating_end.
floating_end frames 8–14 end floatingmode: an idle hover lands 1.9 s after shots 1–3, 1.5 s after shot 4.
floatingmode survives only the skills in its inherit list (the floating skills and the floating combo): a grounded skill ends it.
potential_atkup and the combo-slot swap end with floatingmode; floating_end and shot 4's end reset the ABATK index.
